About Ethio-Asham

We are building an asset-light approach to agricultural mechanization, coordinating existing equipment and operators to serve organized agricultural demand more efficiently.

🚜 Mobilize Existing Assets

Bring under-utilized agricultural machinery into a more organized service model.

📊 Improve Utilization

Coordinate machinery, operators and agricultural demand to make productive use of available capacity.

🤝 Connect Demand & Supply

Help agricultural businesses, cooperatives and emerging corporate farms access mechanization services.

Asset-Light Mechanization-as-an-Input-Service (MaaS)

Mobilize and coordinate existing machinery assets so they can be accessed more efficiently by agricultural businesses, cooperatives and emerging corporate farming enterprises.
